raw_text: BREAKING NEWS BULLETIN: India faces economic collapse as GDP growth plummets and unemployment reaches record levels. Internal unrest spreading across multiple states. International investors pulling out amid political instability. Experts predict further deterioration in coming months. Full report from our correspondent in New Delhi.
clean_text: Telegram channel broadcast fabricated anti-India news bulletin using AI-generated news anchor. Content about economic collapse and internal unrest entirely fabricated. Infrastructure traced to Islamabad and Shenzhen servers.
